newsitem.title: USA: NU sees no Millstone power for summer peak.
newsitem.headline: NU sees no Millstone power for summer peak.

text.p: Northeast Utilities does not expect any help from the Millstone nuclear power plant in meeting peak demand next summer, the utility said Tuesday.

In its report of fourth quarter results, the company said it expects at least one of the three shut-down Millstone units to begin operation in the second half, "but not until after the summer peak electric demand season is over."

Since mid-December, NU has been saying it expects one of the units to be ready for restart in the third quarter with the second and third units ready to go in the fourth quarter of 1997 and first quarter of 1998, respectively.
To this it has added the note that none of the units can resume operations until the Nuclear Regulatory commission formally votes to permit restart.
